title: Rise Reforming (YC S26) Is Hiring
summary: Rise Reforming, a Y Combinator S26 startup focused on clean hydrogen production through reforming technology, is actively recruiting a Senior Chemical Process Engineer to join their team and contribute to their decarbonization mission.
problem_solved: Scaling clean hydrogen production to help decarbonize hard-to-abate industries and reduce global carbon emissions
why_valuable: Provides an opportunity to work on critical climate technology at an early-stage YC-backed startup with significant growth potential
